y0: Those Who Love the Highest Places
y1: The Pharisees spoke well, but they didn't do what they said. They dressed up their clothes to be seen by people, and they wanted to sit in the highest places at feasts.
y2: Jesus said, “He who is greatest among you will be your servant. Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”
y3: Like a Hen Gathering Her Chicks
y4: Jesus looked at Jerusalem and was sad: “O Jerusalem, Jerusalem!”
y5: “How often I wanted to gather your children together, just like a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you didn't want to.” Jesus wants to hold us in His warm embrace.
y7: The disciples were amazed by the big and beautiful temple building. Jesus said, “There will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”
y8: Jesus said there would be wars, earthquakes, and hard times in the future. But “he who endures to the end will be saved. This Gospel will be preached in the whole world.”
y10: Jesus will come again. But no one knows the day and hour. That is why Jesus said, “Be watchful!”
y11: Blessed is that servant who faithfully does his given work, no matter when his master comes. We too live well every day, waiting for Jesus.
verse: “Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”
prayer: Jesus, thank You for holding me in Your embrace just as a hen gathers her chicks. Let me not boast, but serve with humility. Let me live watchfully and faithfully every day, waiting for the day You come again. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: Pharisee. They were Jews who tried very hard to obey the law. But many only cared about how they looked on the outside. The Pharisees loved the highest places.
d1: humble. To be modest without boasting. Whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
d2: hen. A mother chicken that raises chicks. A hen gathers her chicks under her wings.
d3: endure. To keep going without giving up, even when it is hard. He who endures to the end will be saved.
d4: watchful. To stay awake and be ready. Be watchful!
d5: servant. A person who does their master's work. The faithful servant is blessed.
